function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Verifies customer identity against record using last 4 digits of PAN or birth year. MUST be called and must return verified:true before any debt information is disclosed.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account ID. Always use ACC-88392 for this call.

verification_code.description: The 4-digit code or birth year provided by the user (e.g. 1234 or 1995).

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Logs the agreed promise-to-pay date and amount committed by the customer.

ptp_date.description: The date the customer agreed to pay. Prefer ISO format YYYY-MM-DD when possible, otherwise keep the spoken form.

amount.description: The amount the customer agreed to pay (normally 8499).

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Triggers an instant payment link via SMS or WhatsApp to the customer's registered mobile number.

channel.description: Delivery channel for the payment link.

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Logs the final outcome of the call. Must be called at the end of every conversation.

status.description: Final disposition status of the call.

notes.description: Optional free-text notes about the conversation.

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Hands the call over to a human agent for complex cases such as disputes or hardship.
